meta_description:
143K likes, 2,474 comments - shivesh17 on April 15, 2025: "Still trying to wrap my head around this… but I DID IT. I BOUGHT A HOUSE.

this has been my dream for so many years now & it’s one of those v rare occasions where I’m so proud of myself🥹🥰

I’ve quite literally grown up on the internet—started sharing my life here when I was still in school, kept at it through undergrad, and eventually took the leap to become a full-time content creator. In these 10+ years, I’ve shared all my big & small milestones with YOU- you’ve been there through all the highs, lows, and everything in between♥️

As I turn 29 next week, I’m beyond grateful to have had so many of you cheer me on & encourage me to chase my dreams🥹 

I’ve just uploaded an empty house tour on my YouTube channel—click the link in my bio to watch 👀 Here’s to new beginnings, and to building a home filled with love, warmth, and memories.".
